calibration.note: Re-running a committed vector on this host reproduces its recorded cycle count exactly, which is what licenses the rows below.

committed_whole_run_leaves.note: The eight k=156 leaves of the LunarLander t1248 tree. Their cycle counts are recorded per leaf in the tracked provenance above; re-running them here in execute mode reproduced all eight to the digit, which is the calibration this sweep rests on.

minatar_leaf_cycles.note: A projection, not a measurement. The k=156 witness at this width is 3.3 GB and the executor's shared-memory ring could not back it on the measurement host.

width_ratio_at_k4.note: Measured, not extrapolated: same dataset, same settings, same step count, only the hidden width differs.

known_limits.executor_ceiling: Cases whose witness passed roughly 50 MB failed with SIGBUS in the SP1 native executor on this host. Widening /dev/shm from 5.8 GB to 9 GB let the 86 MB case through, so the ceiling is host shared memory, not SP1 and not the cycle count: 2.03 billion cycles completed fine.

measurement_host: WSL2 Ubuntu on Windows 11, 20 vCPU, 11 GB RAM, CPU executor

minatar_reference.caveat: The guest evaluates a dense Linear-ReLU-Linear network. The 10197-unit rows match MinAtar's parameter count to within one parameter (132,565 against 132,566), not its convolutional structure.
minatar_reference.game_dependence: Channel counts differ by game (Breakout 4, Freeway 7, Seaquest 10), so the parameter count varies by under 1% across the suite. The rows here match Breakout.
minatar_reference.note: MinAtar's DQN example: nn.Conv2d(in_channels, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=1) over the 10x10xn state, then nn.Linear(1024, 128) and nn.Linear(128, num_actions). num_actions() returns 6 for every MinAtar game; Breakout's state has 4 channels.

what: SP1 guest cycle counts for the training_fragment relation as the hidden layer and the step count vary. Execute mode only: these count cycles, they do not prove, so no row here is proof-backed.
why: The discussion section's cost for a MinAtar-sized network was an estimate with no derivation. These rows replace it.
